$comment: Single source of truth for the Accordion API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: A stack of sections that open and close, like an FAQ.
thumb:
Is it free?
Yes, MIT.
Which styles?

type.description: One section open at a time, or any number.
type.html: single: the same name="…" on every <details>

defaultValue / value.description: Which sections are open. Use onValueChange to hear about changes.

examples.title: One at a time
examples.description: Opening a section closes the others. In HTML, give every <details> the same name; no JavaScript needed.

examples.title: Many at a time
examples.description: Leave out the name and each section opens on its own.

examples.title: Outline
examples.description: Each section in its own frame.

a11y: Built on <details> and <summary>: the browser makes each header a button that says "expanded" or "collapsed", and Enter or Space toggles it.
Find-in-page (Ctrl+F) opens a closed section when it finds text inside.
The chevron is decoration drawn by CSS.
With reduced motion, sections open without the slide.
